maya: heads-up: CI started failing intermittently on eval-runner tests after the protobuf bump to 3.21. seeing flakiness in promptset fixtures — ordering / serialization mismatch when examples are round-tripped.
sam: can you paste the failing stack + a tiny repro?
maya: here's the stack we get in the runner job:```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/eval_runner/serialize.py", line 88, in serialize_promptset
    out = message.SerializeToString()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/google/protobuf/message.py", line 123, in SerializeToString
    return _InternalSerialize(self)
AssertionError: map key order mismatch when merged with existing message
```And when we diff the serialized json we see ordering differences across runs. staging passed repeatedly, only main CI shows occasional nondeterministic diffs.
jia: weird. protobuf should be stable but 3.21 introduced some map iteration changes. what's the protobuf version on the failing runner?
maya: `pip freeze | grep protobuf` -> `protobuf==3.21.4` on the failing image. locally i was on 3.20.3 and didn't hit it.
noah: CI images were rebuilt yesterday (python 3.11 + ubuntu 22). python's hash seed might be affecting dict order for maps if code relies on insertion order somewhere. can you repro in the same docker image?
maya: repro steps:```docker run -it --entrypoint /bin/bash redwood/ci-image:2026-03-18
# inside container
git checkout main && pytest tests/eval_runner/test_promptset.py::TestSerialization -q
# sometimes passes, sometimes fails after ~3 runs
```
sam: immediate mitigation: pin protobuf==3.20.3 in the eval CI job and set env var `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` for pytest steps. i'll open a draft PR for the pin. this should stop red herrings while we investigate. :thumbsup:
jia: long term we should make serialization canonical in the eval harness: sort map keys explicitly when converting proto->json and add an assert helper `assert_canonical_serialization(fixture)` so any nondeterminism fails fast. i'll sketch a small util to canonicalize.
maya: agree. also let's capture raw bytes and `hexdump` on failure so we can see the exact diff and track whether it's a proto serialization quirk vs our wrapper. add `--show-diff` to failing test runs.
noah: I'll roll the protobuf pin into the base CI image and add an infra ticket to audit all image rebuilds for dependency bumps that affect serialization. cc: @ci-bot to create the ticket.
ci-bot: automated: created ticket INFRA-4821 "Investigate protobuf serialization nondeterminism in eval CI" and attached last failing job logs. :robot_face:
sam: opened PR #4122: `ci: pin protobuf to 3.20.3 and set PYTHONHASHSEED=0` — tests passing on my fork, requesting review. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4122
maya: thanks. once PR merges i'll run 5 full pipeline runs overnight and follow up with a small eval-harness test that asserts round-trip equality for promptset fixtures.
jia: for the spec side, propose we add a short doc in docs/promptset/serialization.md describing canonical rules (proto version, json options, required ordering) and a pre-commit check that flags non-canonical fixtures.
noah: sounds good. marking this thread as tracked; will update INFRA-4821 with the canonicalization proposal and timeline. :white_check_mark:
